cards.title: Keep delivered as the stored status
cards.body:
Keep delivered. Neither idle nor waiting is a better stored status.

  • delivered: the crewmate finished and its worktree is still present
  • done: landed, merged, or answered

cards.title: Who sets delivered
cards.body:
The host writes delivered at close time.

  • a finish whose branch has commits
  • before PR 95, an idle cancel as well

cards.title: Setting delivered is deterministic
cards.body: Yes: the close path decides from the record alone, with no model in the loop.

cards.title: Folding the delivered change into FI3-62
cards.body:
What folding means

FI3-62 already changes how an idle cancel closes; folding the delivered change into it keeps one PR for one behavior.

Step 1

Walk the close path for the finish case, record which status it writes, whether it stamps closed_at, and whether the worktree is retired or kept, then compare against the board query so the delivered rows it lists match what the record says.

Step 2

Walk the close path for the idle cancel case, record which status it writes, whether it stamps closed_at, and whether the worktree is retired or kept, then compare against the board query so the delivered rows it lists match what the record says.

Step 3

Walk the close path for the discard case, record which status it writes, whether it stamps closed_at, and whether the worktree is retired or kept, then compare against the board query so the delivered rows it lists match what the record says.

Step 4

Walk the close path for the land case, record which status it writes, whether it stamps closed_at, and whether the worktree is retired or kept, then compare against the board query so the delivered rows it lists match what the record says.

Step 5

Step 6

Walk the close path for the supervision close case, record which status it writes, whether it stamps closed_at, and whether the worktree is retired or kept, then compare against the board query so the delivered rows it lists match what the record says.

Step 7

Walk the close path for the boot reconcile case, record which status it writes, whether it stamps closed_at, and whether the worktree is retired or kept, then compare against the board query so the delivered rows it lists match what the record says.

Step 8

Walk the close path for the purge case, record which status it writes, whether it stamps closed_at, and whether the worktree is retired or kept, then compare against the board query so the delivered rows it lists match what the record says.

Step 9

Walk the close path for the drop case, record which status it writes, whether it stamps closed_at, and whether the worktree is retired or kept, then compare against the board query so the delivered rows it lists match what the record says.

Step 10

Walk the close path for the import case, record which status it writes, whether it stamps closed_at, and whether the worktree is retired or kept, then compare against the board query so the delivered rows it lists match what the record says.

Step 11

Walk the close path for the hygiene sweep case, record which status it writes, whether it stamps closed_at, and whether the worktree is retired or kept, then compare against the board query so the delivered rows it lists match what the record says.

Recommendation: fold it in, with the evidence rule as the single gate.
